notes.title: The Dark Congregation Rises! Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Hi! 

This week I continue working on the cave system and its inhabitants. My current focus is the monster known as The Dark Congregation.


The Dark Congregation
The Dark Congregation is a massive Dark One whose body is formed from a swarm of smaller monsters clustered around a glowing red relic. Deep in the cave system, their combined Dark Energy creates a halo above its head.

Long ago, an ancient miniature civilization mistook this halo as divine — a belief that ultimately led to their destruction. Wielding a staff of solidified golden syrup, the Dark Congregation strikes its own halo to conjure waves of devastating magic.


Original Design
This was the first take on the Dark Congregation — already creepy, with the clustered body and glowing relic.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a868568235533f6aa13d2cc0f1c7624cda105f55.png"]


Refined Design + Idle Animations



In the updated design, you can see a lot more presence: the staff is larger and more ornate, the cloak and form are more defined, and the halo effect feels sharper. The new Idle animations bring him to life, making the whole creature feel even more ominous.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/5e8a9c49699640dce8adce072e4e2f6625d08252.gif"]


New Projectile Attack Animation
Here’s one of it's new attack animations — an updated version of his projectile attack. When his staff hits the ground a magical golden orb is expelled towards his target.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/9c2f1d9cd1f7c50da89013ee87626acd8e970a26.gif"]




New Secondary Attack Animation
His secondary staff attack will make traps appear around him that you may also be able to use against him and his horde of followers. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2f0b24c713c2d7367b8db66b848c0ddc5cb861c8.gif"]



That’s all for now on The Dark Congregation! I’ll be sharing more of his progress — including new attack patterns and abilities — in the next update post, so stay tuned.

James -  @iENDERi

notes.title: ✨ Bombing my way Into the Caves – Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, James here with another weekly Adventure Craft dev update!



In this video I try to bomb my way into the new cave system to show you how things are shaping up underground. The caves were one of the very first things I built for the game, and over time they got left a little incomplete as I focused more on the surface. With the next update they’re getting a full overhaul.

Now the caves will feature:

A variety of Gem Biomes you can search and mine

Updated artwork for stalagmites, pillars, rocks, and treasure chests

Ancient ruins from a lost civilization you can explore and break apart

New gem deposits (and special pickaxes to mine them)

Gem monstrosities and other new enemies guarding these areas

And plenty of tweaks to make the caves more dangerous but way more rewarding

Everything in the footage is still work-in-progress — I’m testing with debug items (and blowing myself up with bombs way too often 😅). But hopefully this gives you a taste of how much deeper and more alive the caves will feel.


[previewyoutube="nXBqZocHu48;full"][/previewyoutube]
Here are some screenshots! Almost all of the art assets in the caves are being updated to match the overall look of the rest of the game. I’ve always loved making creepy stuff, so it’s been a lot of fun applying my current pixel art skills down here.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/224834751c761f65fa0b2d6865f016097c879ad6.png"]

The new cave system will have 14 different Gem Biomes to discover, each with its own unique set of enemies. These areas are always in conflict thanks to the mining operations going on down here, so expect things to get pretty chaotic when you explore.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c8effe4e34358bdeedcb275f09fecd089798fda1.png"]

There’s also a full set of Crystal Armor and a variety of Crystal Weapons tied to each gem type. You’ll run into crystal warriors down here too, and they’re not alone — each one has a Crystal Monstrosity pet by their side.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e5ce48b89a7372915c2ba67ef6033c4b37a7e38d.png"]

The Dark Ones will show up in much greater numbers now, making the caves a constant danger. Exploring underground won’t just be about mining — you’ll always have to stay on your toes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1df413128ebe754b12d5fccb8c498a47332b74f1.png"]

To balance out the danger, there’ll be a variety of treasure chests hidden around the caves to make exploring more rewarding (and to keep you pushing deeper).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/6334cc2afe3560205aeae6e295704a6389d8566f.png"]

That’s it for this week’s update! Thanks so much for checking out the progress — it means a lot to me. Your feedback and support are a big part of what keeps me working on this game after all these years.

I’ll be sharing more updates soon as I polish things further. In the meantime, let me know what you think of the new caves and which features you’re most excited to try.

See you in the next one!

– James @iENDERi

notes.title: Update 1.24 (Sound Effects)
notes.notes:
Being one of only two people working on this game has required me to wear many hats over the years. Which is good because I love hats.

But one hat that I haven't worn in a long time was the sound effects hat. This is sad because sound effects have such a huge effect on how a game feels. Sound connects the player to the world in a way that only it can. It brings personality to the game world and communicates more to the player in many cases than the visuals alone allowing the player to feel more connected to the world.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1826aa1550701077d07a19d12a655d7adab5174e.png


The content in the game has grown considerably over time and was in dire need of many more sounds. We didn't have enough time to include the sound update in 1.23 so we decided to complete it now before we move on to other things. So I'm very happy to report that we have added a ton of new sounds to many aspects of the game for version 1.24


Sound design is not really my area of expertise however I have attempted to really immerse myself into the process and have worked to try and pick nice quality sounds that enrich the game experience. I also have had a close friend who is learning the sound engineering ropes lending me a hand. The initial results have felt very good and have made the game world feel much richer and more alive, and also much more humorous at times.

We have updated many aspects of the sound effects including...

Characters Idle Sounds
Each character in Adventure Craft has a slot for multiple Idle sounds. This is a collection of sounds that they can make when they are just hanging around, helping the player to become aware of their presence. We had a look at nearly every character and faction and have updated their sounds to give them more personality. 

So now for example when you are near Punks you will hear them make little Negative "Heh"s or when you are near Special Forces you will hear their radio chatter calling out Bravo! Echo! etc. Cockroaches and spiders hiss and skitter and Lumberjack Mechs rev their chainsaw engines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a119e47cdff6d91f6c734e8e54b5ad72ff5496f6.png



More dangerous enemies like werewolves have a warning sound slot, so you may hear a howling sound when one is near.

Character Attacks
We have updated many enemy attacks to have new sounds like slicing sharp blade noises and crunchy and booming impacts to bring extra impact and weight to their attacks.  

Weapons 
We have updated the swinging and impact sounds for many weapons so that hitting someone over the head with a pipe sounds different than hitting them over the head with a wooden sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/18ff5c6e78c44c2f1206c7c64f6bf2f256d3675d.png

And there is more to come.

It is still a work in progress so there is plenty of room for further improvement so please leave me any feedback about how the game sounds now so that we can continue to enhance the sound over future updates. 

Twitter: @iENDERi

notes.title: Adventure Craft Update 1.1 is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We are happy to report that the Adventure Craft 1.1 update is now available in the main branch of the game. The 1.1 update brings a ton of new features, content updates and bug fixes. Now onto the details! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/6b3614fd7c2b0103e4567f1192387fe1aa2ad964.png

Extended Day and Night Cycle
The day/night cycle has been slowed down again making for much longer days and nights, which allows for more time to explore or gather resources in the day but can make being out at night more dangerous.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/54bda6f108031b614ea0d252f8e98d143ffe4de4.png

Respawning in your bed
After you die you will now respawn back in the last bed that you slept in, or if you die in a “portal world” like a cave system where you don't have a bed, you will respawn outside the portal.

Death Penalty Removed
You no longer will lose everything if you die twice in a row, you can now always venture back to where you died to retrieve your dropped inventory.

Epic Criticals for weapons 
The majority of weapons now have a chance to land an “Epic Critical” which is a double damage critical hit. Epic critical chance is typically half the chance of whatever the weapons current critical chance is set to.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/046fee8db11a87383d85bb16870ce10327037d15.jpg



Wiki Data Spreadsheet
The Spreadsheet that contains all the game’s recipes and other data is now available for public viewing. You can find it here. (Note: This spreadsheet is a work in progress, missing info will be updated, please inform us of any inconsistencies in the data)

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QBOFHFp7Lq2CmBnUZR_C3Ldah8X1Wq9dKi4Eh4NfVbc/edit?usp=sharing

If you would like to help us move this data onto our Official Adventure Craft Wiki, you can find the wiki here.

https://adventurecraft.gamepedia.com/Adventure_Craft_Wiki

Town Updates

Town Graveyard
Activity in the town graveyards has been increased. Haunted chests protected by poltergeists can now be farmed for special items, and a town grave keeper now roams the area hunting the undead. You may also encounter a powerful  Brute Vampire or Brute Ghost hunter in this area.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/9d761d6794bf56bba6c1f015398d1748a5b27c20.jpg


Vampire Mansion
You can now enter the tomb at the back of the vampire mansion (if you have collected the keys) to fight the bosses inside. This is a tough battle that will require a Spectral Sword and/or Stake Guns to win. Having a party with you that is equipped with these types of weapons will make this battle much easier.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c341d79ebac6dc8a12e99d02223058ae32be16ba.png

Town Farm
Activity in Town Farms has been increased. Farmhands will now gather wheat and leave piles that you can farm if you have a pitchfork. They will try and protect their harvest so beware of their dogs if you get too close. The activity inside pens has also been updated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e2889d6607a70a4ac092691ec0eee9400f8ee843.jpg


Town Center Weapon Shop
The town center weapon shop has had more weapons added to its inventory.

Misc Gameplay Updates

Dog Power 
An attack dog that has reached its final stage of evolution can now use its power which is an attack that will cause Fear to any nearby mob that isn't immune to Fear. Press N to activate the power. It has a 300 second cooldown. (There is no visual currently to show the attack but this will be added in a future update)

Clone Party Updates

Clone Speed: Clones will now match your speed if you use a speed increasing items so that they don't get left behind. 

Toggle Clone AI on off: You can now use the numbers 7 and 8 to toggle a clone’s AI on or off quickly. This is useful in battle when you need the clones to stop what they are doing and follow you. 

Goblin Tech Tree
We have adjusted the way that goblins camps evolve over time. Now you will see a pile of Goblin Supplies that will eventually activate. Once activated goblins will begin to spawn from it and try to deploy tents to expand their territory.

New Tile Maps

Voodudes
The Voodudes have now been given their own new biome along with a new weapon to craft. Their biome is also home to a new mob, The Brutal Voodude. Farm him to craft a Voodude Club, a heavy poisonous club that inflicts many status effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/bfc74a4742f6bcbea12bffe22dbe93b4d63562e2.png

notes.title: Development Update 08/7/2020
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We want to apologize for the lack of information concerning the next update to Adventure Craft. A lot has happened since the last update which has slowed down the already incredibly slow development for this project, but believe it or not, I have indeed worked on the game nearly every day since the last update and there is a substantial amount of new free content still coming by the end of the year.

Sorry for not posting regular information here on the Steam page. There have been some really lovely long-standing fans who have been with us from the beginning, many who had paid for the game, who deserve to know what's going on. Those early funds helped keep our heads above water and enabled us to keep the game alive during its initial development. So we apologize to all those folks and thank you for your support.

The Future

On the bright side of things, I have very recently had some changes in my circumstances that will hopefully facilitate more work being done on the project so that we can finally complete the game's core experience, move the game out of Early Access, and provide more consistent content and information updates. 

We plan on continuing to enrich the free core Adventure Craft experience until it is something that is worth paying for. Once we achieve this we will then start the process of making the optional paid high level DLC dungeons, the first of which will be free for all existing customers who paid for the game's initial development. The core game will still receive updates and remain free. 

What's coming in the next update?

Here are some images with descriptions of a few of the things that I've been working on that will be in the 1.1 Adventure Craft update.

We have spent time updating the artwork on the world to make it more beautiful and to add more visual interest and variety{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/37bb97b0c3706cc9bf333e9debe027f8a465bfbc.png

Cave Women

Another new Faction is cavemen and cavewomen. Cave Women are a "Brute" class humanoid that wield massive wooden clubs. Their weapons require Ancient Knowledge (a loot drop) that you can use to craft their awesome club.

Tile Map Diving Art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/37bb97b0c3706cc9bf333e9debe027f8a465bfbc.png
I have started adding large pieces of non-destructible environmental art to help divide the landscape. This creates more mazelike pathways through certain biomes and also prevents the player from building there in order to create more variety and richness in the visuals.

The Deacon's Bell
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/fea6587fc19ee55391b985f6b0c81a2c7ad4bae6.png
The Deacon's Bell is a new weapon that can be crafted from new loot dropped by the Dark Congregation boss down in the cave systems. It shoots a golden fireball like the one that the Dark Congregation uses. The fireball will push enemies back and also sets close mobs on fire when it's rung.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c80e5198daabaf417756a9535778036a96dc05ca.png
This Giant Cleaver can be crafted from loot dropped by a new Brutal Zombie that you will find roaming the graveyards tile maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e1553bd9562ac36473e13af1d3387bbf5193a7ed.png

Goblin Tech Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/92c9a8562000c7e963caaa362f9066fd3e5c01a4.png
Some new work has gone into how a mob camp can develop over time. We started with the Goblins around the spawn. You will see "goblin supplies" that can be used by goblins to establish small camps that will grow over time and need to be dealt with before becoming an issue. 

Fishing Hole Updated
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/7ebd263b93763fa21692e4bbdc4ab6b25de98e64.png
There's a variety of updates to the fishing holes and fishing shops. And some new weapons that you can use to deal with Sabertooth Bubblers.

Party Bullies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2e3a953b1f7a6bcaa781be9cc04ce207cdde33a0.pngThese pink bullies are new friendly mobs that will fight by your side and can transform normal goblins into friendly Party Goblins. A special item can also be acquired at the Dark Carnival to summon a Party Bully to help you win a tough battle. 

Brutal Voodudes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/bfc74a4742f6bcbea12bffe22dbe93b4d63562e2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/84573ae3fb23f61a806c07557e2ce3aa98b5c56b.png
The Voodudes have now been given their own new biome along with a new weapon to craft. Their biome is also home to a new mob, The Brutal Voodude. Farm him to craft a Voodude Club, a heavy poisonous club that inflicts many status effects.

Flaming Greatsword
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a2662c722518fc3dc0d662923a82210b507652a9.png

We have already made an enormous amount of new content and additions over and above what is listed above, but it would take far too long to list it all, and we want to keep some surprises for you guys as well. notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

Well, it is a relief to be able to make this post and to say that the 1.05 update is now in a playable state. We have been working on this for so long, so it's really good to get it into people's hands and we look forward to working with people on it. Finally! There is a huge amount that has been added and changed, and below you will see the major things listed. They only account for about a third of all the changes, but they are the most important ones from a player's perspective. All in all we hope that the changes make the game a more fun and rewarding experience.

We have now deployed the 1.05 update to a Testing Branch so that players can have a chance to play it and test it for bugs before we deploy it into the main game. The patch will stay in testing between 1-2 weeks before it gets added to the main game.  

If you would like to try the 1.05 Update you simply right click on the Adventure Craft title in your games list and select properties.Then click on the BETAS tab and select the Adventure Craft Testing branch of the game. 

This will give you access to the testing version of the game without affecting your main game save. To switch back to the normal version just right click on the testing version in your game list and switch it back to NONE in the Beta tab with the drop down menu.

Please keep in mind that the 1.05 update is very large and is still a work in progress. It contains many new features, items, and other content that has been internally tested but also contains many elements that are still incomplete or in need of tweaking. 

Please be sure to report any bugs, crashes or other weird things that you come across in the discussions section of the game's Steam page. We will be checking there daily to address anything that you find. 

Patch Notes

Here's a list of the most significant changes that have been made since the last update.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Players will no longer lose their entire held inventory if they die a second time, instead the players inventory will simply drop where the player died and will stay there until retrieved.


Towns
The biggest part of this update is the Towns that you can now find in the world. Towns are composed of several tile maps each with a different theme or purpose. 

You will know that a town is near when you enter the White Knight controlled town border tiles, which are full of bright white stone walls and other White Knight structures. In the town center you will find an Inn where you can spend the night, as well as static item shops that sell both common and unique items.

Additionally you will find a Farm, Graveyard, residential area that you can build your own structure on, a Ghetto or Slum area, as well a mysterious mansion.

notes.title: Update on Free to Play Price Change and Monetization
notes.notes:
Hi, 

Thanks so much to everyone who responded to our "Fate of Adventure Craft" announcement! I was very touched by all the kind words about our game. It felt really good to read that. 

We have been communicating with Valve about the change over the past couple of days and we have been approved for Free to Play! We have also been advised that we will indeed be able to reward our existing paid players which I am really excited about.

They also advised us on our plan about setting up a subscription model which has informed us on how to move forward with monetization.

Here's a rough overview of my plan moving forward. 

Obviously this is all subject to change, but this should give you a general idea of what's happening in the short term.

------------------------------------------------------------

Deploy Price change on July the 11th. From that point forward, the Core Game will now be offered PERMANENTLY for Free. All content updates to the Core Game will be free. Once the price change goes into effect we will...

Finish configuring the 1.05 update and get it ready to deploy.

Deploy 1.05 to the testing branch for one week.

After the test week Deploy 1.05 to the main game package.

Address any issues with 1.05.

From this point we would like to release an update every 1-2 weeks to the core game. First to a testing branch for a week of testing, and then moved into the main public game. (You will be able to opt in and test the patch and provide feedback before it gets deployed to the main game if you would like to.)

...........................

Monetization

Rather than the subscription model...

All updates to the core game will remain Free. New recipes, items, Tile Maps, monsters, gameplay refinements etc, will be continually added to the core game to foster its continued evolution. 

We will periodically release Paid DLC in the form of "End Game Dungeons/Item Packages", the first of which will be automatically Free for existing Paid Players. 

The End Game Dungeon DLC will be high level "non persistent" worlds that will mainly appeal to people who have put enough time into the base game to have a set of weapons/equipment/items capable of surviving them. (I'll tell you more about how we plan on doing the DLC's and our plans for how they affect the Core game for Free players and Vice Versa as we move forward).

If you want insider info on this or have a question follow me on Twitter @iENDERi and I'll answer your questions.

notes.title: 23 New Images and an Update about version 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

We just wanted to post an update to let everyone know what is going on with the development of Adventure Craft. We realize that it has been a very long while since we have released an update for the game or posted any news, which has lead some folks to ask us whether or not the game is "dead" at this point and why there haven't been many news updates about the game's progress etc. 

So with this post we want to...


 address some of these questions and concerns
 inform you on where things are at and where they are going
 show you a small selection of some of the new things coming to the game



So is the game dead?!

The short answer is No, the game isn't dead. We have still been working on it since the last update was released nearly a year ago and we have no plans to abandon it.

Is the 1.05 update still coming this year?!

No, the official update won't be coming until early 2019.

Why not? And why is it taking so long?!

After the last update we decided to add full NPC Towns and NPC Structures to the world map. This ended up being a much larger undertaking than we had initially predicted.

The concept was to have villages of various sizes, from small "Single Tile Map"  villages to "Very Large Villages" composed of multiple Tile Maps. 

We decided that, rather than starting with the simple small villages, we would start with the large more complex villages first because the large villages would incorporate the majority of the new features that any other future village might contain and help inform the addition of the smaller villages later.

As we began implementing the large villages to the game world, we realized how much work was ahead of us, and that it wasn't going to be a simple as just throwing the villages in and testing them along side the community as with other updates. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c108a095b993d3b423eee2572c3f213edfdd0a99.png

A Large Village covers a 5x5 tile area of the world map and is comprised of 25 Tile Maps of various types, such as White Knight border Tiles, farms, a town center, town graveyard etc. Each individual tile map in the Large Villages also contains new characters, static shops, and various new items and weapons which affect existing areas of the map and systems.  

Since Edible Entertainment is comprised of only two people, one artist/game designer and one programmer, progress was very slow indeed!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/07abb02ab644704dfbdb9a199e2d6afa967d7917.png

A posse of pitchfork wielding villagers out for a stroll down to the local vampire residence. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c341d79ebac6dc8a12e99d02223058ae32be16ba.png

A vampire and his minions enjoying the cool night air.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/83953ec560ada7dcfaf01ef7f784bc55d04ae00e.png

Various new items. Fishing Nets, Dynamite, Holy Grenades, Big Game Guns, Harpoon Guns, Battle Axes, Machetes....

So now what?!

So as mentioned above, we have been continually working on the game for about a year since the last update and we will continue to do so until the update is ready sometime in early 2019. Lots of new items, equipment, and weapons have already been added but we still have a lot to do before we can release it.

Thank you so much for your patience with this next update! We sincerely can't wait to get it into your hands and continue this journey together!

In the meantime we have selected a bunch of images to show a small taste of what's to come. These are in no particular order. 

Continuing to Enhance the look of existing Tile Maps and Art Assets

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d4b23d1fb7d8a947b187ed74c6ea9c51f6b3b872.png

We have been updating the look of the game world with additional details and objects like this new grass that populates between dirt and grass.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/b1b80cdd972cb9ddc6e5b5648daa86d37a423f4e.png

New foliage and details near water transitions for creatures to hide in, as well as new crafting materials to collect like these shells.

In areas like the Badlands, this creates more opportunity to use the environment to  get away from dangerous enemies so that they can't simply run up to you and kill you if you need to flee because they will have to run around large things in the environment.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/54bda6f108031b614ea0d252f8e98d143ffe4de4.png

Creepy Tentacles coming from the night time storms.

Thorn Forests

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/05ad3feaf6cadb8e0d032034596586068a424aa2.png

Thorn Forests are dangerous new biomes full of lots of dangerous new creatures to fight and rare powerful items to acquire. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/27924936fed498b92badd98eee86b49d35a0ffdf.png

The Thorn Lord Creepeth

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c674c121966cdf13e51032eb31cce75a95151155.png

Giant thorn tentacles will burst from the ground in huge hordes seeking to kill anything that disturbs the ground. You will be able to craft special weapons that they are weak against to cut through their ranks in search of the treasures they protect.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/e96f51bb9cf842d1a294e6a80ca06820b1ed736b.png

Strange Bulbs that can develop into giant plant monsters can be found throughout the Thorn Forest. Destroy them before they have a chance to grow up! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/b5448ff4af8a0be55fdcd35e8c963116fc3e79c8.png

Fishing

One of the new Tile Maps are Fishing Ponds that will be generated throughout the world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c7c027201509c9d21a06b830c3bd4603aaff8dfc.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/5cf598d8de3b81d0e89a0e6ff031cfc72cfa86fe.png

notes.title: 15 New images and information on the Upcoming 1.05 NPC Village Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We have had our heads down working hard on the next big update for Adventure Craft and have not had much time to post any news in a while, but we wanted to let everyone know that we are still alive. A few people have wondered if we have abandoned the project but we assure you all that we have not abandoned it! In fact we can't wait for you to play what we have in store for the next update!

So we decided to post some new images and talk a little bit about each one as another "preview post" for the upcoming 1.05 NPC Villages update. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/a47b659b93b3f568cac419719e44c693b42cdfd6.png

Please note that all images posted here are works in progress and do not reflect the final quality.  So here we go!

NPC Villages
The major focus of 1.05 is the addition of NPC villages and NPC Structures to the World Map. The villages will vary in size from small vulnerable single tile map villages, to large 25 Tile White Knight protected Towns like you see here.

A White Knight Village on the Map
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/275596bbf66cfd7fa53da84b785ebca089727d18.png

The White Knight Villages will expand the overall presence of the White Knights in the world, including adding new members of The White Knight's Order like the "High White Knight"

High White Knight Patrolling with a Crew
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d367667ea317f244fc9704798d7805c457a63af2.png

High White Knight Powering Up
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/3e1750cb3ef0a883c2d911c645c59e3e90c6bcb6.png

High White Knights are MUCH more powerful and WAY faster than a typical White Knight and can dish out enormous damage to anything they engage in battle. Battles involving High White Knights are a spectacular show of force that can be dangerous to behold, especially if a High White Knight falls in battle to a creature of Darkness and is transformed into the dreaded Red Knight! 

White Knight Fighting the Darkness
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/7b333076aed4bb7d8684a8f965d115ea079ba891.png

Inside the White Knight Villages
The Interior tile maps of White Knight Villages are composed of several different "themed" tile maps, each having its own gameplay and content. Here's an overhead view of a few of these. A Neighborhood, Town Graveyard, and Town Center.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/708b87d28d65fd9ccf46192f4d289d636746e9ae.png

Neighborhoods
Neighborhoods are populated by NPC's just going about their daily lives. NPC's will leave and come home, have wake/sleep cycles, and can make their own decisions about how to interact with you based on your behavior. This will give you the opportunity to do things like break in and steal their stuff if you like when they are away or asleep. But BEWARE! NPC residents will defend their property if you are discovered! 

Town Graveyard
Town Graveyards are spooky places with creepy things that can sometimes creep into town causing various problems for a town's inhabitants. 

Town Center
The Town Center contains static shops that will give you reliable access to items, weapons etc, as well as the usual pop up shops and other fun activities. 

Town Center Weapon Shop
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d025e1117b77fde139281f11b13271282a239fab.png
Here is an image of the Town Center Weapon Shop, where you can buy things like scrap and other weapon and equipment related items.

Town Center Potion Shop
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/6b63e840d052bb15e51be3cef96d7b2c293e0a71.png

Town Center Teleporter
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/eb0c9f7d4e31fcbd84ac3487b21fbada76eb4088.png
Each town center will contain a teleporter that will link to your existing teleporter network once you have accessed it.

In addition to the tile maps listed above, White Knight villages will also contain: White Knight Border Mazes and Districts, Slums, A Farm, A Mysterious Mansion and even and "Real Estate Tile Maps". Purchase a deed and you can build your own house within the town.

Giant Roaches are a common problem in the Slums
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c930754413b6946eac88bba7f77c2f9ce59e2fd2.png
The Slums are the home of many unsavory characters who will sell you things like lock picks and other illegal items if you can put up with their roach infestation.

Uncover the secret to the Mysterious Mansion
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/823c901a18bc5bcda3c0801bff6015e2a622d79a.png
Who are the creepy people who inhabit the Mysterious Mansion? Why do they only come out at night? Why are they chasing you with a knife?

New Weapons, Equipment and Items

Each new tile map in the 1.05 update will include a selection of new weapons, equipment and recipes to discover. 

White Knight Armor Set
Build your own set of White Knight Armor and Join the Order Yourself!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c5f1278cae64edcee8b468e7003897903d0fa9b6.png

Powerful New Bombs that can create Nuclear Wastelands
The explosive weaponry of the White Knights can sometimes create serious problems if not used with caution. And sometimes if used with caution! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/859f2d2cb4a29c0cafb1c1ef2b768e9f8ff8dd89.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f2b879ed422e2d626f1804e8405b09039dcea59c.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/0d76f1261c04df1c9b904b2113b622c3442af1c7.png

So the question is...

WHEN CAN WE PLAY IT?!?!!

This is only a small taste of the changes coming in version 1.05. It is the largest content update that we will be releasing so far, so it will take us some time to get it ready for public testing. Currently we are shooting for the first quarter of this year for the release. But we will try to release it as soon as possible so that you all can play it and start giving us feedback. Thanks for your patience!

If you have any questions for us please feel free to Post messages in the Adventure Craft Discussion Forum here on Steam or contact me directly via Twitter @iENDERi


Thanks so much for reading!

notes.title: Version 1.05 Preview, NPC Villages, New Boss, and more!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We have been hard at work putting together the Adventure Craft 1.05 update and because of it's size, it's taking a bit longer than expected. So we just wanted to make a post showing what we are working on and share a little bit of what you can look forward to when the update is released.

(Note: All images are of works in progress and will change between now and the release of this update)

NPC Villages!

One of the first big new additions are the NPC Villages/Towns Biomes! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1e43ec3c5656b87d8b7e699431418f6865ea2325.png

NPC Villages are large biomes where you can find NPCs living and going about their daily lives, Static Shops, and village based gameplay scenarios. The Village biomes are made up of a "Town Border" tile map that surrounds and protects the biome, an "Inner Area" composed  of varying "Districts", and a "Town Center". Whilst NPC villages are generally much safer than most other areas of the game world, their border may still be attacked by roaming monsters and sneakier creatures who have "ways" of finding their way inside.

First we will talk about the Town Border which is occupied by the mysterious White Knights. Here you will find the White Knights going about their business, training, and getting ready for their nightly battle against the forces of darkness, as well as various White Knight structures and curiosities. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f06f862d16a090ff0b031cf0288a60b81b4e2245.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f5518f19e099106e8f0b0707f2e136e51bd73f73.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9057f3a51097a86e2794d130eb555e51ff885a92.png

Town Center

Past the White Knight occupied Town Border is the "Inner Area" where you will find a variety of tile maps that make up the districts that rest of the village is composed of, as well as the "Town Center" that lies in the middle of the Biome.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/93a853802c2d72096bc4f5fad55472d27ec8a604.png

The Town Center will feature a set of Static Shops and Businesses that will provide reliable access to many of the game's items as well as special items and fun diversions that can only be found in the Town Center.

Here is an image of the General Store in the Town Center.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/15aa9b2835d5a33e9d6e7fa8c150952cfc6b2a21.png

The town center will also feature an Inn! Grab a drink at the bar, or stay the night. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/297ba527c17b02eac3b53bf3edeccae0c514365c.png

Class Based Neighborhoods. 

The inner area of the village will feature neighborhood like tile maps that are themed after a sort of "social class" system. These tile maps will be set up as Slums, Middle Class and Upper Class neighborhoods for NPCs. Each neighborhood will have different content and gameplay scenarios based on the class of NPC's that live there. The NPCs that live there are also being updated to behave as if they really occupy their dwellings, including going to bed within specified time ranges, leaving and returning home as part of a routine, and reacting to the player actions within their homes.

Here are a few images of the "Slum Neighborhood" tile map.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/7dcddd8910fbff0801f5b2df1b51d93f79cc152f.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/62e8d642496b27f787cf71751e2853b134a711bf.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/42ef1305b1aa72f6070a387f40cbd4e83f77dbae.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9da6ec37047845d0401a69df8f9504a54716e219.png

Town Graveyards.

The Town Graveyard tile map is a unique place within a village because unlike the other districts which are generally safe, it can be a dangerous place to visit particularly at night.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/429dca15338bc3dbeb4b8146ee9c0f7ecab2e649.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ca9c39105725128e1943ef7ed54a670a082c7255.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/cff8b70914f1f48bf5e522f9e9342172afe28028.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/4bd91be6809f058cc7e992fecdd59d61dab7d1ea.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/19fbc17aa94b15d2a21972202c13dbd2b7b73e76.png

Real Estate Districts
Whilst you won't be able to simply build structures in the main districts of a village due to the many permanent NPC structures and objects within them, you WILL have the option to use your gold to purchase a deed to one of the "Real Estate" tile maps within the village. Once purchased you will be able to build up a base within one of these virtually empty tile maps.

Farms
Just like the other districts, the NPC farm district will contain a farmhouse, and other farm related items and gameplay.


New Boss and Equipment "Spoiler Alert"


The Colossal Boar is a HUGE new boss enemy that will provide a significant challenge to defeat. Covered in the weapons of defeated warriors foolish enough to try and take him down, you will find him in being worshiped by the Boarmen in the center of the new Boarman Biome. Defeating Colossal Boars will provide you with the materials needed to Create the Colossal Boar Armor and Weapons. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/fb6571c8eade332e4e1b20d8cedfa1b005a0030b.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1d70d7fb59a978d8a1516a87a6960d1ed0500f44.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ffd626452970513fbe0fa2f3cfd5a5b9fea66a68.png

Colossal Boar Armor

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/99f82bfb6ff7384f1fe33bc004b7c56dac1d5c06.png


Some final words about another upcoming change that may or not be included in 1.05 but is in the pipeline for the VERY near future.

As the world and content of Adventure Craft continues to expand, more powerful new monsters, events, and areas will be continuously added, along with the valuable rewards for overcoming them. Because of the procedural generation aspect of the game, the chance of swift and unforeseen deaths will increase. Particularly during unprepared inventory retrieval which could cost you everything. Because of this we are currently in the midst of evaluating the penalty for second death in the game, and designing additional options for inventory retrieval. 

Thank you so much for reading this post! We hope that you are enjoying the game!

@iENDERi

Here you will find the White Knights going about their business, training, and getting ready for their nightly battle against the forces of darkness, as well as various White Knight structures and curiosities. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f06f862d16a090ff0b031cf0288a60b81b4e2245.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9057f3a51097a86e2794d130eb555e51ff885a92.png

Town Center

Past the White Knight occupied Town Border is the "Inner Area" where you will find a variety of tile maps that make up the districts that rest of the village is composed of, as well as the "Town Center" that lies in the middle of the Biome.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/93a853802c2d72096bc4f5fad55472d27ec8a604.png

The Town Center will feature a set of Static Shops and Businesses that will provide reliable access to many of the game's items as well as special items and fun diversions that can only be found in the Town Center.

Here is an image of the General Store in the Town Center.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/15aa9b2835d5a33e9d6e7fa8c150952cfc6b2a21.png

The town center will also feature an Inn! Grab a drink at the bar, or stay the night. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/297ba527c17b02eac3b53bf3edeccae0c514365c.png

Class Based Neighborhoods. 

The inner area of the village will feature neighborhood like tile maps that are themed after a sort of "social class" system. These tile maps will be set up as Slums, Middle Class and Upper Class neighborhoods for NPCs. Each neighborhood will have different content and gameplay scenarios based on the class of NPC's that live there. The NPCs that live there are also being updated to behave as if they really occupy their dwellings, including going to bed within specified time ranges, leaving and returning home as part of a routine, and reacting to the player actions within their homes.

Here are a few images of the "Slum Neighborhood" tile map.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/7dcddd8910fbff0801f5b2df1b51d93f79cc152f.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/62e8d642496b27f787cf71751e2853b134a711bf.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9da6ec37047845d0401a69df8f9504a54716e219.png

Town Graveyards.

The Town Graveyard tile map is a unique place within a village because unlike the other districts which are generally safe, it can be a dangerous place to visit particularly at night.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/429dca15338bc3dbeb4b8146ee9c0f7ecab2e649.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ca9c39105725128e1943ef7ed54a670a082c7255.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/cff8b70914f1f48bf5e522f9e9342172afe28028.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/4bd91be6809f058cc7e992fecdd59d61dab7d1ea.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/19fbc17aa94b15d2a21972202c13dbd2b7b73e76.png

Real Estate Districts
Whilst you won't be able to simply build structures in the main districts of a village due to the many permanent NPC structures and objects within them, you WILL have the option to use your gold to purchase a deed to one of the "Real Estate" tile maps within the village. Once purchased you will be able to build up a base within one of these virtually empty tile maps.

Farms
Just like the other districts, the NPC farm district will contain a farmhouse, and other farm related items and gameplay.


New Boss and Equipment "Spoiler Alert"


The Colossal Boar is a HUGE new boss enemy that will provide a significant challenge to defeat. Covered in the weapons of defeated warriors foolish enough to try and take him down, you will find him in being worshiped by the Boarmen in the center of the new Boarman Biome. Defeating Colossal Boars will provide you with the materials needed to Create the Colossal Boar Armor and Weapons. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/fb6571c8eade332e4e1b20d8cedfa1b005a0030b.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1d70d7fb59a978d8a1516a87a6960d1ed0500f44.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ffd626452970513fbe0fa2f3cfd5a5b9fea66a68.png

Colossal Boar Armor

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/99f82bfb6ff7384f1fe33bc004b7c56dac1d5c06.png


Some final words about another upcoming change that may or not be included in 1.05 but is in the pipeline for the VERY near future.

As the world and content of Adventure Craft continues to expand, more powerful new monsters, events, and areas will be continuously added, along with the valuable rewards for overcoming them. Because of the procedural generation aspect of the game, the chance of swift and unforeseen deaths will increase. Particularly during unprepared inventory retrieval which could cost you everything. Because of this we are currently in the midst of evaluating the penalty for second death in the game, and designing additional options for inventory retrieval. 

Thank you so much for reading this post! We hope that you are enjoying the game!

@iENDERi

notes.notes:

Updated description for Strong Mer Helmet (it said you could use it to breathe underwater but this ability will be added to it in a future update)

notes.title: Update 1.02! Is here! Balance Changes and new content!
notes.notes:
Hi! This patch is primarily focused on general game balance as well as some character specific balancing. There's also a bit of new content in there as well. 

 Interface 

Added an indicator button to the map to show where player homes are located, 
map blocks with existing houses must be revisited in order for this update to take effect, homes placed after should be indicated 


 Gameplay and Content 

Added "Brutal Punks" to The Badlands. They are very strong Punks who roam The Badlands gathering wandering Punks into a mob 
Updated art of Punk Dog house destruction
Added Bread recipe drop to wheat
Added nails to stolen bag loot drop
Added new loot drop "Grim Biscuit" to Goatmen (cures doomed)
Added Human Skull and Grim Biscuit to potion shop
Added Recipe Drop "Grim Biscuit" to Goatmen
Added effects to hitting Dark Zombie Totems
Updated "Stone Sword" description
Chickens can now lay nests of eggs rather than a single egg


General Balance

Decreased White Knight's HP from 150 to 125
Increased Blind Status effect duration from 10 to 15 seconds
Increased poison Life % damage from 10% to 15%
Poison now reduces move speed by 25%
Poison Status effect can now be renewed by poisonous attacks before ending
Decreased durability of poison bow from 15 to 10


Character Specific Balancing

Giant Spiders

Giant Spiders are now immune to poison.
Increased Angry Spider's chase speed from 275 to 300
Baby Spider's attack now has 25% chance to poison
Increased Baby Spider's attack damage from 5 to 7
Increased Giant Spider's attack damage from 8 to 10
Increased Giant Spider attack's poison chance from 50% to 75%
Increased Giant Spider chase speed from 225 to 300
Increased Giant Spider's ability and probability to web a tree
Spider food now spawns Angry Spiders on destruction


Giant Boars

Giant Boars now have a chance to invoke haste when aggroed
Giant Boars now have a chance to invoke Strength 
Decreased Drop Rate of pork chops from Giant Boar
Decreased loot drop probability of Godlike Boar Tusk from death of Giant Boar from .75 to .50 
Increased Giant Boar Chase Speed from 301 to 310
Increased Giant Boar Critical attack chance from 25% to 35%
Increased Giant Boar attack damage from 12 to 15


Giant Crab 

Increased Giant Crab life from 150 to 200
Increased Giant Crab deflect projectile chance from 25% to 50%
Increased Giant Crab chase speed from 140 to 200
Decreased drop rate of crab eggs from giant crab
Giant Crab now immune to burn and fear


Mason (Rare Night Mob)

Increased Mason's HP from 1000 to 2500
Mason now immune to poison, sleep, doomed and bleeding
Increased Mason's block chance from 5% to 10%
Mason now has 5% chance to deflect a projectile 
Increased Mason's chase speed from 295 to 305


Punks

Increased Punk spawns from punk structures
Increased Punk Builder's structure building probability.


Bug Fixes

Updated indicators on Gnomes to correct positions
Fixed bug that allowed a Punk Builder to drop pipe pickaxes instead of the recipe
Fixed loot drop probability bug on mobs dropping loot while affected by status effect

notes.title: Update 1.01 is Now live!
notes.notes:
Hi! We are happy to announce that Adventure Craft 1.01 is now live! Huge thanks to everyone who has provided feedback! Here are the patch notes. 

UPDATE 1.01

 INTERFACE


Added "quick cut/crush" buttons to recipes in the recipe window. These buttons will appear above a recipe ingredient when you have the item and recipe that the ingredient is derived from, through cutting or crushing, in your inventory. Pressing the "quick cc" button will automatically process your materials so that you don't have to leave the recipe window as often when crafting
Added a search field to the recipe menu to filter the recipe list to help find recipes faster
The workbench crafting menu will now automatically be available if you are standing near a deployed workbench when you open the inventory 
Added a "SHOW REPAIR" recipe toggle button. This button will toggle display of only REPAIR recipes in a category.
Added a "NEW" button to recipe menu. This button will toggle display of ONLY new recipes in a category

 GAMEPLAY AND CONTENT

Added the ability to craft "trunk drawers" to trunks and weapon and equipment lockers which allows you to double or triple the storage space of these containers.
Added the trunk drawer recipe to drop from destroyed trees
Added deadly new full moon scenarios 
Added punk scrap picks to Punk drops
Added "punk signage" object to badlands (drops nails when hit with pipe axe)
Added an Indicator to Punk Structures that require Pipe Pickaxe to destroy
Punk structures now drop nails when hit with a Pipe Pickaxe
Friendlies spawned from the "mysterious device" at the spawn will now attempt to kite enemies when they fight 
Pipes and rusty wedges are now dropped by Punk House and HQ builders
Punk Builders now have the ability to change certain dead trees into "punk signage"
Dead trees (in the badlands)  can now be destroyed with the pipe axe (they don't drop loot yet though)

 BALANCE

Decreased the speed at which time passes slightly, creating a slightly longer day and night cycle
Decreased drop rate of clone inventory bags from golden chests
Decreased the durability of the "Call to Worship" from 25 to 20
Slightly decreased loot probability on boar carcasses when using the hunting knife
Increased enemy presence in caves
Increased the overall availability and drop rate of nails
Increased the spawn count of sugar cane in marshy areas
Increased the repair cost of a damaged "Call to Worship" from 2 to 5 Golden Syrup
Increased the repair cost of a completely broken "Call to Worship" to 2 golden ropes and 5 Golden syrup
Increased resistances to transformation attacks on stronger enemies
Increased Dark Zombies' attack poison chance from 25% to 35%
Increased Dark Monstrosity chase speed from 295 to 325
Increased Dark Monstrosity maximum simultaneous spawn from a Dark Zombie portal from 3 to 4
A Chomp's attack now has 25% chance to poison

 BUG FIXES

Made optimizations to reduce cpu usage
Fixed bug where Mer would drop mer shoes as loot rather than the recipe.
Fixed bug where holy water was free in shops
Fixed bug on some blueprint drops that made them harder to see at night since they were being lit by the environment
Fixed a bug where clones could heal dogs with non dog items like potions
Added better Unicode file system support
